notes.title: Caput Mortum Version 1.2.0.0
notes.notes: [p]Another lil' patch![/p][p]Here are the fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed a couple of issues with the Steam achievements. Those who had trouble getting them can retry from any checkpoint or by restarting a new game, and the achievements should now unlock![/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where you couldn't drop items after activating the last flower apparatus.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in the main menu where the game would stay in "mouse and keyboard" mode.[/p][/*][/list][p]We also added some more control options:[/p][list][*][p]The game now supports AZERTY keyboards (option available in the Accessibility menu).[/p][/*][*][p]You can now use "C" as well as "Ctrl" to crouch.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you![/p]

notes.title: Caput Mortum Version 1.1.0.0
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p]First off, I wanted to thank you all so much for the incredible reception the game has gotten so far! It makes us so happy to see our weird project inspire and fascinate so many people <3[/p][p]We have fixed a few issues in 1.1.0.0, so here they are:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed two issues with the 'Untouchable' achievement: the achievement check is now reset when starting a new game, and both endings trigger it correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the accessibility settings not being loaded properly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the flashing intensity option.[/p][/*][*][p]Polished a few enemy navigation areas.[/p][/*][*][p]Set-up a new fallback font for extended Latin characters.[/p][/*][*][p]Modified some of the collisions on the furnace.[/p][/*][*][p]You can no longer see a prompt through the secret chest.[/p][/*][*][p]You can no longer hit skeletons once they are dead.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some minor particle effect issues.[/p][/*][/list][p]If you have any questions or comments, please do not hesitate to post them in the forum. Thanks again!![/p]

notes.title: Demo Version 0.2.6.2
notes.notes: [p]Here are the changes in version 0.2.6.2![/p][p][/p][h2]Localization[/h2][list][*][p]Japanese has been added![/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug that removed player's input when timing an attack with the homunculus' dialogue.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved uncrouch detection.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a display bug with the dropping item tutorial when triggered before the crouch tutorial.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Progress on the main game has been going very well and we're super excited to see people's reactions to the new areas and enemies >:) We've also made a good amount of polishing and minor bug fixes in the full version, but didn't include them in the demo since it would require a lot of unnecessary time. However, please let us know if you come face to face with a very nasty bug![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you![/p]

notes.title: Demo Version 0.2.6.1
notes.notes: [p]Here are the changes in version 0.2.6.1![/p][h3]NEW SETTING OPTIONS[/h3][list][*][p]If you are easily motion sick, you can now disable all camera shakes in the options menu![/p][/*][*][p]The FOV can now be set from 80° to 110° in the options menu. We recommend keeping the default of 90° if you can.[/p][/*][/list][h3]BUG FIXES[/h3][list][*][p]Moved a previously unreachable hiding spot for the homunculus.[/p][/*][*][p]Attempted a fix for the rare occasion where dropping the cane in the Living Quarters would spam the notification sound effect. If you encounter this bug again, we would appreciate a detailed breakdown of how it occurred to you (control method, prior actions, hardware, etc.).[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks a lot for the reviews and discussions you've all left! We are really proud of this project and we can't wait for you to experience the full thing later this summer ^u^[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo Version 0.2.4
notes.notes:
Here are the changes in version 0.2.4!

- Made the homunculus' hand game more forgiving.
- Added a caption when you're full on healing herbs.
- New Game Over sting.
- New keyboard only option. Moved sheathe/unsheathe to R.
- Rework of the control's code and the settings menu.
- Tweaks to the post-processing.
- Fixed a lighting issue in the Living Quarters.

I also updated the game's manual! You can download it from the store page :)

notes.title: Demo Version 0.2.3
notes.notes:
Big thanks to the people who have shared the issues they encountered with us. If you enjoyed the demo, please write us a review on the demo page :)

Here's what's been fixed and added in version 0.2.3

- Disabled the item drop action while using a weapon or holding healing herbs.
- Homunculus now has more health and says, "Copy my hand".
- Homunculus now shoves the player away while giving the tutorial. Fixed a few other issues.
- Reworked the game initialization process when resuming from a game over and/or from the title screen.
- Normal doors don't play the web sound effect when attacked anymore.
